title: Selecting an inactive part in global search opens the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A.
  • Make sure the Search box in the top bar is the global search, which lists inventory parts.
  • Start on any page other than Inventory, such as Work Orders.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Search box in the top bar.
  2. Type part A's part number.
  3. Click the part A result.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The global search opens.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed with its grey "Inactive" tag.

Step 3:

  • The Inventory page opens on the Inactive tab (selected), with part A's part number in the Search box and the part A row listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R18: “Global search lists inactive parts at the current location. Each carries the grey "Inactive" tag.”
  • S9-R19: “Selecting an inactive part in global search opens the Inventory list on the Inactive tab, searched to its part number.”
